payload.title: gateway-api upload and delete handlers for chemical and batch documents check only authentication and tenant, so any tenant member of any module can attach files to, or delete regulatory documents (MSDS, health certificates) from, any farm chemical or batch
evidence: apps/gateway-api/src/upload/upload.controller.ts:143-144 (UploadController carries no role, module or site decision)
apps/gateway-api/src/upload/upload.controller.ts:240-252 (chemical upload checks only req.user and tenantId)
apps/gateway-api/src/upload/upload.controller.ts:287-291 (stores under the client-supplied chemicalId without verifying the chemical)
apps/gateway-api/src/upload/upload.controller.ts:647-684 (batch-document delete checks only tenant, then deletes the object)
apps/gateway-api/src/app.module.ts:542-588 (the global guards are AuthGuard and TenantIsolationGuard; no role or module guard runs on REST)
payload.rule_violated: D2 (farm-private data is written only by farm grant holders) and the plan's decided default that a site assignment is a physical restriction for MODULE_USER callers.
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-43, release R4.
